content.body:
As part of US prewar armored vehicle doctrine, tanks were meant to accompany infantry while enemy tanks were engaged by a specifically-designed antitank reserve. War experience soon showed that towed AT guns, while cheap, we altogether too immobile for the fluid realities of tank warfare. The M10 Wolverine was the first purpose-built replacement for the ad-hoc or "portee" style AT guns (AT gun mounted on halftrack or truck chassis) that US divisions employed in North Africa.
Based on an M4 chassis, with a lightly-armored open-top turret the M10 was nevertheless reasonably successful due to its high-velocity 76.2mm gun, which was originally based on the 3 inch Anti-Aircraft gun. Despite formal doctrine, the practicalities of combat usually meant that they ended up being employed as general-purpose light tanks with extremely potent guns, in which case the open top proved a serious liability. The tank was forever associated with Audie Murphy, the most-decorated US soldier of WW2, when he earned his Congressional Medal of Honor by holding off a strong German force of tanks and infantry by resolutely manning the .50 caliber HMG atop a burning M10.
Control Variations: The M10 is most successful when its used precisely as it was designed ... as a motor carriage for a good AT gun.
Despite its classical tank appearance, it is not capable of trading sustained fire with enemy tanks to do so will quickly result in a dead M10. The 76.2mm gun shoots flat and is easily capable of effective hits at long distances so every effort should be made to engage at range, well out of the threat of enemy infantry (especially rifle grenadiers). Shoot a relatively few shots and relocate. Pay particular attention to your aerial cover, as even a brief strafing run with the lightest of weapons can end an M10 mission immediately.
The exceptionally slow turret traverse means a much more difficult task tracking fast-moving targets at short or close range so keep your enemy out a ways where you can follow them more easily in your gunsight view. The 3" M3 gun will kill other AFVs at extremely long ranges, with the exception of the really heavy stuff like the Tiger or Panther which require you to be a little closer to do the job.
content.brief: TYPE: Medium AFV (Tank Destroyer) ARMAMENT: 76.2mm Main gun 1 x .50 caliber HMG WEIGHT: 29600 kg SPEED (road): 40 km/h
content.title: M-10 Wolverine
